video_10_post_rally.description: Tracker follows background objects after last rally event (frame 370). Kinematically indistinguishable from real ball contacts.

fp_categories_baseline.note: Percentages sum >100 because some cross-video matches inflate per-video FP count vs global

fp_blocker_diagnosis.primary_blocker: video_10 post-rally period (frames 421-1795): YOLO detects moving spectators, ball retrieval persons with conf 0.05-0.53. Tracker follows these objects producing kinematically valid trajectories.
fp_blocker_diagnosis.why_activity_state_insufficient: Post-rally YOLO detections maintain confidence >= 0.08 threshold. Activity state classifier cannot distinguish active rally from post-rally using detection confidence alone.
fp_blocker_diagnosis.why_provenance_insufficient: Post-rally FPs have grounded (DETECTED) frames with plausible single-step distances (11-95px). Static-lock only catches a subset (frames 1348, 1754).
fp_blocker_diagnosis.fundamental_limit: Without a scoring engine, time-in-rally context, or learned background segmentation model, ~60 of the 62 video_10 FPs cannot be suppressed at Stage 3.
